BradyKonkleAlvarezOliva2013ColorAFC.note: Brady, Konkle, Alvarez & Oliva 2013 JEP:General Exp 1. Color 2AFC: studied hue vs. same object rotated 180 deg. Long-delay: 340 objects at 1 s each (100 tested; 200 fillers + 40 back-to-back repeats). Short-delay: 3 objects shown simultaneously; observers did not know whether color or state would be tested, so it is not a pure color-only WM estimate. Per-group N=20.
